VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify that acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 64 tests pass and provides a plausible technical explanation, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate:

1. That the identified root cause (float-precision drift) was actually the source of the race condition
2. That all 64 tests actually pass
3. That the fix was correctly implemented
4. That the solution addresses the actual token-refresh race condition rather than a different issue

Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and require corroboration for acceptance criteria verification, especially for production-critical fixes.
